items.title: Garrett Wilson: Geno Smith and I were heated, but not at each other
items.text: At one point in the fourth quarter of Sunday's 28-25 loss to the Dolphins, CBS cameras caught an animated Garrett Wilson expressing himself in the vicinity of quarterback Geno Smith.

items.title: Jonathan Taylor puts Colts up 7-0 after Vikings fail on fourth down
items.text: The Vikings got a big kickoff return to open Sunday's home game, but the Colts are on the board first.

items.title: Colts stretch lead to 10-6 just before halftime in Minnesota
items.text: The Colts have a halftime lead in their first game of the post-Chris Ballard era.

items.title: Kyler Murray uses arm, legs to give Vikings 13-10 lead in fourth quarter
items.text: It has been a frustrating afternoon for the Vikings offense, but the fourth quarter started off in better fashion.

items.title: Vikings shut Colts out in second half, improve to 6-0 with 16-10 win
items.text: The Vikings rallied after halftime to improve to 6-0 on the season.

items.title: Aaron Jones aggravated his knee injury in Sunday's win
items.text: Vikings running back Aaron Jones was called questionable to return after going to get his knee checked out on Sunday and he did not return for the final minutes of Minnesota's 16-10 win over the Colts.

items.title: Colts have not considered QB change as Shane Steichen sticks with Daniel Jones
items.text: As Shane Steichen's job hangs in the balance, the Colts coach is sticking with quarterback Daniel Jones.

items.text: The 3-2-1 Giants have made a quarterback change in advance of the city known for countdowns.

items.title: Giants, Texans tied 14-14 at halftime
items.text: It's been a day of comebacks in Houston.

items.title: Giants beat Texans 27-21 in overtime
items.text: Giants RB Cam Skattebo ran 42 yards to the Houston 30 in OT, and Devin Singletary scored on next play.

items.title: Cam Skattebo felt something in his hamstring on final run in OT
items.text: The Giants have a bye in Week 8 and that might be good news for running back Cam Skattebo.

items.title: Zay Flowers 48-yard touchdown gives Ravens early 7-0 lead
items.text: Zay Flowers has done it again.

items.title: Ravens dominating time of possession, lead Bengals 13-0 at halftime
items.text: Though Lamar Jackson is missing his third consecutive game with a high-ankle sprain, the Ravens’ offense has been plenty effective.

items.title: Bengals score two TDs to take 14-13 lead over Ravens in third quarter
items.text: Though the Bengals were thoroughly dominated in the first 30 minutes of Sunday's matchup with the Ravens, they were down just 13-0 at halftime.

items.title: Bengals blank Ravens in second half, win 35-13
items.text: Joe Burrow tossed four touchdowns in the second half, as Cincinnati scored TDs on five consecutive possessions.

items.title: Aaron Rodgers's next touchdown pass will move him to third all time
items.text: As Aaron Rodgers prepares to become the first quarterback in NFL history to play in four different countries, he's on the verge of taking over third place on the all-time touchdown pass list.

items.title: Jaylen Warren runs Steelers to early lead over Saints in Paris
items.text: The Steelers' offense continues to revolve around Warren.

items.title: Saints benefit from questionable replay review on T.J. Watt strip sack of Tyler Shough
items.text: What appeared to be a Saints turnover was overturned on replay, leading to a Saints field goal in Paris.

items.title: Steelers kick last-second field goal to take 13-10 lead over Saints at halftime in Paris
items.text: It's been a back-and-forth battle today in France.

items.title: Josh Jacobs' TD gives Packers 14-10 lead after Lions' second lost fumble

items.title: Jaylen Warren and the Steelers run over the Saints in Paris
items.text: Warren had another big performance as the Steelers won the NFL's first-ever game in France.

items.title: After Deshaun Watson pick, Tony Pollard's second TD gives Titans 14-0 lead
items.text: So far, it's been all Titans in Nashville.

items.title: KC Concepcion has 129 yards, Browns lead Titans 17-14 at halftime
items.text: The Browns got down early, but have been able to claw their way back against the Titans to take a 17-14 lead at halftime.

items.title: Browns move to 5-2 with another game-winning field goal, defeat Titans 27-24
items.text: Somehow, the Browns have done it again.

items.title: Cleveland's long late gain by Harold Fannin Jr. should have been nullified by a false start
items.text: The Browns' game-winning field goal in Nashville was set up by a 36-yard catch-and-run by tight end Harold Fannin Jr.

items.title: Buccaneers have played in 12 straight one-score games
items.text: If the league office has a favorite team, it's currently the Buccaneers.

items.text: Baker Mayfield is back, and apparently, so are the Buccaneers.
